scope: Isolated Edge Chromium UI + real Node content service; CEP File.path and host responses simulated; no live AE or physical OS drag

results.name: Panel drag highlight follows enter/leave without obscuring events
Dropping a folder renders recursive real filesystem assets
Multiple files form a selected-only group and clear an old search
Repeated rapid drops are guarded while the first is registering
Readiness guards block drops while a host result is unconfirmed
A partial batch retains valid material and shows a rejected file reason
Absent native paths show a fallback instead of registering a guessed path
Panel reload restores actual dropped registrations and source-only selections
Narrow/wide layouts avoid horizontal overflow and the overlay fits the viewport
The complete drop flow never requests any AE write operation
